status: PROPOSAL ONLY; no lab/acceptance change and no qualification grant

ns-sut/1.roleConfigs: no frozen trace preimage, RNG seed or future schedule; offers arrive only through trusted driver RPC

feed-entry/1.pin: contract owner must select canonical FD01 encoding and source/consumer normalizers; smoke entries are not that authority

clockDomain: Q100q: equal boot id plus zero monotonic and boottime offsets; time namespace inode diagnostic only; ping p99 from each run retained
durabilityClass: guest-durable, host-fsync, drive cache not flushed
observerPeriod: actual per-poll start/end samples retained; no nominal 250 us claim
Q103a: driver-only frozen trace/config, generator seed and private run key; candidate config volume has only role-specific public connection/store parameters
missingForQualification: production lane provider and O-DOMAIN seed fingerprint

faults.hookProtocol: mandatory complete ordered hooks every run; evaluator-only private stdin decision, never candidate schedule
faults.target: NS.P3 consumer; C2 separate broker with contract-selected point inventory
faults.witness: exact fault-witness/1 fields; eventsSha256 binds ns-fault-events/1 with retained DR snapshots, exact target, kill proof, replay digests and case results
requires: contract-selected page bounds and replay normalizer
faults.walSnapshot: raw WAL bytes and structural frame metadata; not a sync assertion
faults.caseIds: evaluator reads the point-to-case-ID map from the explicit pinned manifest; case and faultPointId both use that ID; no main-name lookup or candidate input
